# To freeze a new append (Plugin::kMorphTailIds): add its ids at the END in
# live order (a per-osc base, then its +1000 twin) and set the `layout` line to
# the marker that append wrote. T13 admits at most one unfrozen append, and
# only with the marker already bumped past this file's `layout`.
